selected_bases.role: Purple two-lobe shell with a negative-space command chevron.
Ivory continuous folded-paper shell, open left and folded at right.

purpose: Five refinements of selected24 and five refinements of selected35. Concept50 blends35 structure with24 colors. Opaque concept artboards; original assets preserved; no app icon replaced.

concepts.name: 紧凑开壳
concepts.change: 缩短双瓣跨度，收拢成更紧凑的小图标轮廓。
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / precise-object-edit.
Brand: DockShell, an original macOS SSH terminal application. The user selected the supplied original concept and wants an intentional refinement family, not an unrelated new logo.
Create ONE finished refinement on ONE square artboard. Preserve the selected design's specific shell-and-terminal visual idea. Strong optical balance, clean edges, generous whitespace. No contact sheet, no explanatory text, numbers, watermark or slogan. No extra symbols, external >_ glyph, app frame, shield, lock, terminal screenshot, sea illustration, literal seashell ridges, bird, boat or paper airplane. Any command opening must be part of the shell geometry itself. No commercial logo references. Use only the named text when asked; otherwise remove the original wordmark and show the emblem alone. Keep the background opaque.

Input image 1 is the structural edit target, original concept24. Preserve its rich violet upper/lower curved shell lobes, joined or visually meeting at the right tip, and the white right-facing command-arrow cut BETWEEN the lobes.
Refine proportions: shorten the left-reaching lower lobe and thicken the upper lobe slightly so the whole mark fits a near-square silhouette, with a calmer, more balanced upper/lower mass. Preserve recognizably unequal two-lobe structure, not a symmetric butterfly. Make the white chevron cut bold and open, the shell-to-arrow relationship unmistakable at thumbnail size. Two subtly different solid violet tones, no glossy material. Pale lavender-white background, emblem only, no wordmark. Large centered mark with ample margins.
